CUSTOM-001.name: ICMP connectivity test
CUSTOM-001.response: Verify the source and intended connectivity check. This informational rule is not evidence of an attack.

CUSTOM-002.name: TCP SYN burst
CUSTOM-002.response: Inspect destination-port diversity and failed connections. Confirm whether an approved scanner or retrying client caused the burst before containment.

CUSTOM-003.name: Cleartext credential field
CUSTOM-003.response: Identify the HTTP service, stop using real credentials over cleartext, and require HTTPS. Rotate any real credential that may have been exposed.

CUSTOM-004.name: HTTP traversal pattern
CUSTOM-004.response: Review the requested route and server logs, verify path normalization and access controls, and investigate repeated requests from the source.

CUSTOM-005.name: Training DNS indicator
CUSTOM-005.response: Verify the query and its originating process. This reserved domain is a training indicator, not a claim of real threat intelligence.

ML.name: Suspicious traffic pattern
ML.response: Inspect the feature values and surrounding activity. Confirm the event using host/network evidence before taking containment action; model scores are not proof of compromise.
